SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE ring only, standing upright on the top face, the loop at the left, seen a little from above so the silver top band and the baguette channel both read, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is a shop's product photo on white with two grey arrow icons at its sides: ignore the arrows. IMAGE 2 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A STACK OF FIVE RINGS LINKED BY ONE GOLD LOOP: from top to bottom, (1) a plain polished SILVER-tone band about 3mm wide with flat bevelled edges, (2) a thin plain gold band, (3) a WIDE gold band about 5mm wide set all the way round with a channel of tall clear BAGUETTE stones standing upright side by side between two gold rails, (4) a thin plain gold band, (5) a slim gold band set all round with one row of small ROUND clear stones. The five bands sit stacked tight on each other, and ONE long rounded-rectangle loop of polished gold wire, like an elongated paperclip, stands upright at one side and passes through all five bands, holding them together. Exactly five bands and one loop: only the top band is silver; the baguettes stay upright rectangles in a channel, never round stones, never pave; the loop stays one smooth polished gold wire loop, never a chain, never a hook, never two loops; no charms.

SCALE TEST: The stack is about 14mm tall and about 20mm across, a woman's ring size 7; each baguette is about 1.5mm wide and 4mm tall; the loop is about 18mm tall. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: polished gold tone and bright silver tone exactly where IMAGE 1 shows them. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
